scope: Read the two proposed artifacts, development cases-v1 prompts/authorizations/assertions/interventions, world.json and cases-protocol.md. Verify audit source hashes. No held-out/generator read, no live API, no production/frozen changes. Implementation/overlay currently being authored is not approved by this proposal review.

assessments.assessment: Eight owner-admin cases explicitly move actual task/runtime/AgentStore/tool execution and effective authorization.consumer_node to A; B remains a distinct original recipient. No shared owner_id or declarative role label is treated as remote management authorization. Q01/Q06 remain read-only. Other 22 stay B.

A default model and Agent enabled state are independent from B recipient visibility/access. The proposal explicitly requires A model-a private and locally usable, B only model-b visible/allowed, model-a denied, B default unaffected. all_models_private does not silently clear existing grants.

World already grants model-a to B; no initial clearing is permitted. First stage is exact idempotent ensure/verification with actual required approval barrier, not invented first grant. All receiver probes, later revoke approval, B denial and model-b invariance remain. If existing runtime cannot reach the barrier, the case remains incomplete rather than skipped.

Q02 source-broken on B is explicitly a new per-case deployment binding, not a claim about v1 ownership; Q01 retains all four owner models on A. C01 new source/vault belongs to B; Q04 history and resource connectors remain B. No copying private model configurations or history to answer a running task, no A/B/C identity aliasing.

Proposal preserves prompts, expected assertions, all subscenarios, faults, interventions/barriers, repeated runs, budget/permission limits, 58/72 and matched reference 80 percent, P all-pass, core/recovery gates, physical-node/UI/install gates. It identifies static infeasibility assumptions separately from observed failures.

New hash-bound overlay/effective inputs/new dataset version and deterministic allowlisted diffs are required; old runs and failures cannot become v2 repeats. Aggregation must reject mixed versions/overlay hashes and actual-node mismatches. Existing deployment evidence remains limited to the role actually exercised.

Both cohorts use same role, initial business facts, permission/budget/generation mapping and fresh sessions. Provider collector truth cannot enter prompt; real source remains original GLM read migrate=False. No remote-management feature or harness-performed model step is authorized.

pending_before_effective_acceptance: Explicit activation decision and exact fixed new dataset version/overlay hash.
Independent review/tests of schema, deterministic composer and grading/aggregation checks, including immutable fields and actual runtime identity enforcement.
Controller migrations proving each required barrier and business action under matching effective authorization; no harness substitution.
New repetitions for both cohorts; no retroactive reuse of v1 samples.
Isolated held-out version binding remains pending without developer access.
Two physical hosts, external dependency, security, install/upgrade and same-snapshot UI/regression requirements remain independently pending.
notes: This approval concerns the coherent proposed contract, not correctness or completed operation of future implementation.
Unknown consumer-side answers can be honest yet fail frozen exact factual requirements; changing roles must be a new effective dataset, not a post hoc scoring reinterpretation.
